title: Signal from Structure: Exploiting Submodular Upper Bounds in Generative Flow Networks
abstract: arXiv:2601.21061v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets; GFNs) are a class of generative models that learn to sample compositional objects proportional to their a priori unknown value, their reward. We focus on the case where the reward has a specified, actionable structure, namely that it is submodular. We show submodularity can be harnessed to retrieve upper bounds on the reward of compositional objects that have not yet been observed. We provide in-depth analyses of the probability of such bounds occurring, as well as how many unobserved compositional objects can be covered by a bound. Following the Optimism in the Face of Uncertainty principle, we then introduce SUBo-GFN , which uses the submodular upper bounds to train a GFN. We show that SUBo-GFN generates orders of magnitude more learning signal than classical GFNs for the same number of queries to the reward function. translated_title: 信号源于结构：在生成流网络中利用次模上界
translated_abstract: 生成流网络（GFlowNets；GFNs）是一类生成模型，它学习按与其先验未知价值（即奖励）成正比的方式采样组合对象。我们关注奖励具有特定且可利用结构的情况，即奖励具有次模性。我们证明可以利用次模性来获取尚未被观察到的组合对象的奖励上界。我们深入分析了这种上界出现的概率，以及一个上界能够覆盖多少未观察到的组合对象。遵循“面对不确定性保持乐观”原则，我们随后提出了SUBo-GFN，该方法利用次模上界来训练生成流网络。我们证明，在对奖励函数查询次数相同的情况下，SUBo-GFN比经典GFN产生数量级更多的学习信号。我们展示了SUBo-GFN在分布匹配方面的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出SUBo-GFN，通过利用奖励函数的次模性获得未观察组合对象的奖励上界，并据此训练生成流网络，在相同奖励查询次数下比经典方法产生数量级更多的学习信号。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SUBo-GFN, which exploits submodularity of the reward to derive upper bounds on unobserved compositional objects for training GFlowNets, generating orders of magnitude more learning signal than classical GFNs with the same number of reward function queries.
